review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Descend into nested details during the page pass**

When a page nests one `<details>` inside another and the inner summary shares a paragraph with its following text, this traversal invokes `elevateSummary` on the outer element first; that visitor returns `SKIP`, so `visit` never reaches the inner element and its summary still renders as the fallback "Details". The page-level pass should continue into nested details (or explicitly normalize them) rather than skipping the entire outer subtree.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
